Getting an answer from The Pave Agent was never really the finish line. More often, it was the start of the next task: turning that answer into a deck for stakeholders, a doc to share with your team, or a dashboard someone can actually look at. Now the Agent can take that next step with you.


## What's New: Generating Files


The Agent can generate real files directly from a conversation—PowerPoint decks, Word documents, Markdown write-ups, and HTML dashboards. Preview them in a side panel as they're built, or download them to keep working locally.


For example, say you ask the Agent to analyze pay equity across a department. Instead of getting a written summary you'd then have to copy into a deck yourself, you can ask for a summary presentation directly. The Agent builds the PowerPoint, you preview it in the panel, and you download it to polish and send.


## Still Yours to Finalize


A generated file is a strong starting point, not a finished, ready-to-ship deliverable. The Agent builds the draft—the structure, the numbers, the first pass at the narrative—and you review, edit, and decide what actually goes out the door. That's the same relationship you already have with everything else the Agent produces: it does the heavy lifting, you make the call.


## Bringing It Together


Documents built this way carry the same grounding as any other Agent answer—the same data, the same sourcing—just packaged as something you can actually hand to someone instead of a chat transcript.
